swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS61221DCKR uses SC-70-6 (6-pin, DCK) while TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs SW), Pin 2 (FB vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs NC), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (EN vs NONE). Soldering TPS613221ADBVR onto a TPS61221DCKR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 49% (TPS61221DCKR: 812 kHz p.14 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 1600 kHz p.9); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS61221DCKR: 4.7 µH p.13 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 2.2 µH p.4); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS61221DCKR specifies 400 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.4) vs TPS613221ADBVR 1200 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5). Remember boost/switch-limited Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle and inductor ripple scaling.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS613221ADBVR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6 V, p.4) than TPS61221DCKR (7.5 V, p.3); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6 V.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (TPS61221DCKR: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to 85°C TA, TJ max 125°C) vs TPS613221ADBVR: -40..125 °C Industrial / Extended (-40°C to 125°C TJ)); TPS61221DCKR hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: TPS61221DCKR (Texas Instruments, SC-70-6) and TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs SW), Pin 2 (FB vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs NC), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (EN vs NONE). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (VIN vs SW), Pin 2 (FB vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs NC), Pin 5 (SW vs NC). Power-stage deltas: boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency 812 kHz (p.14) vs 1600 kHz (p.9) (2x ratio), typical inductor 4.7 µH (p.13) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), output mode fixed vs fixed, and package θJA 231.2 vs 189.7 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS61221DCKR "Pin 2 (FB) MUST Be Tied Directly to VOUT on Fixed 3.3 V TPS61221" (p.3) and TPS613221ADBVR "No Enable (EN) Pin and No True Load Disconnect" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose TPS61221DCKR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SC-70-6 (DCK) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose TPS613221ADBVR when higher switch current capacity (1200 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
